name: XCL World Academy
summary: IB campus in Yio Chu Kang — peer-recommended when families want modern facilities north-east of the CBD without legacy-brand wait folklore.
body: XCL World Academy offers IB education with contemporary campus facilities in the Yio Chu Kang / north-east corridor. Reddit school comparisons sometimes float XCL beside SAS and Stamford when parents want IB without assuming a decade-old waitlist story. Transport and bus routes should be part of the decision; ask about cohort sizes by grade and secondary pathways before signing housing nearby.
waitlistNotes: Newer relative to legacy schools — ask about cohort sizes and mid-year seats by grade.
